BrochureContent.Content:
Truly magnificent 4 bedroom residence with a superb adjoining annex (8A) ideal for extra family member or such like.
Brilliantly located in a lovely private and quiet development on Clybaun Road, within walking distance of schools, shops, church, supermarkets, and enjoys easy access to Salthill Prom, Barna Woods, Silverstrand etc. Also only a short distance to city centre.
BER rating for No.8 is C. BER rating for 8A is D. 
Top class condition throughout and in really good decorative condition. Double glazed, OFCH, excellent attic area, two en-suite bathroom areas, spacious grounds with lovely rear garden and garden shed. Side gates and exceptional off street parking.
Comprising: entrance hallway, sitting room with open fire place, kitchen/ dining room, playroom/study/ optional 4th bedroom with WC and WHB en-suite. Plus, main bathroom. Excellent attic area plus bathroom area. The annex (8A) area comprises of a sitting room, kitchen/ dining room, two further bedrooms, one with WC and WHB, and a further bathroom.
No. 8 is situated in a lovely conclave of detached homes in a lovely family neighbourhood. This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a fabulous detached home in a fabulous residential location.
Full details with John Quinn 091 569 174.
